chapter.heading: BOOK FIVE: Psalms 107—150Thanksgiving to the Lord for His Great Works of Deliverance
chapter.v:
Oh, give
thanks to the Lord, for He is good!For His mercy endures forever. [Num. 11:23; Is. 50:2; Jer. 32:17]

Let the
redeemed of the Lord say so,Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy, [Is. 1:15]

And gathered
out of the lands,From the east and from the west,From the north and from the south. [Is. 1:15, 21; Jer. 2:30, 34; Ezek. 7:23; Hos. 4:2]

They wandered
in the wilderness in a desolate way;They found no city to dwell in. [Is. 30:12; Jer. 7:4 e Job 15:35; Ps. 7:14; Is. 33:11]

Hungry and
thirsty,Their soul fainted in them.

Then they
cried out to the Lord in their trouble,And He delivered them out of their distresses. [Job 8:14]

And He
led them forth by the right way,That they might go to a city for a dwelling place. [Rom. 3:16,] [Prov. 1:16; Rom. 3:15 h Prov. 6:17 i Is. 55:7]

Oh, that
men would give thanks to the Lord for His goodness,And for His wonderful works to the children of men! [Is. 57:20,]

For He
satisfies the longing soul,And fills the hungry soul with goodness. [Jer. 8:15]

Those who
sat in darkness and in the shadow of death,Bound in affliction and irons— [Deut. 28:29; Job 5:14; Amos 8:9]

Because they
rebelled against the words of God,And despised the counsel of the Most High, [Is. 38:14; Ezek. 7:16]

Therefore He
brought down their heart with labor;They fell down, and there was none to help. [Is. 24:5; 58:1]

Then they
cried out to the Lord in their trouble,And He saved them out of their distresses. [Matt. 12:34]

He brought
them out of darkness and the shadow of death,And broke their chains in pieces.

Oh, that
men would give thanks to the Lord for His goodness,And for His wonderful works to the children of men! [Is. 5:23; 10:2;]

For He
has broken the gates of bronze,And cut the bars of iron in two. [Ps. 98:1; Is. 63:5] [Mark 6:6 (Num. 2:10; Is. 59:19). These standards or ensigns raised on a spear or pole (Num. 21:8, 9). These] [Is. 41:28; 63:5; 64:7; Ezek. 22:30]

Fools, because
of their transgression,And because of their iniquities, were afflicted. [Eph. 6:14, 17; 1 Thess. 5:8]

Their soul
abhorred all manner of food,And they drew near to the gates of death. [Is. 63:6; Rom. 2:6]

Then they
cried out to the Lord in their trouble,And He saved them out of their distresses. [Ps. 113:3; Mal. 1:11 y Rev. 12:15]

He sent
His word and healed them,And delivered them from their destructions.

Oh, that
men would give thanks to the Lord for His goodness,And for His wonderful works to the children of men! [[Heb. 8:10;]

Let them
sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving,And declare His works with rejoicing.

Those who
go down to the sea in ships,Who do business on great waters,

They see
the works of the Lord,And His wonders in the deep.

For He
commands and raises the stormy wind,Which lifts up the waves of the sea.

They mount
up to the heavens,They go down again to the depths;Their soul melts because of trouble.

They reel
to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man,And are at their wits’ end.

Then they
cry out to the Lord in their trouble,And He brings them out of their distresses.

He calms
the storm,So that its waves are still.

Then they
are glad because they are quiet;So He guides them to their desired haven.

Oh, that
men would give thanks to the Lord for His goodness,And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

Let them
exalt Him also in the assembly of the people,And praise Him in the company of the elders.

He turns
rivers into a wilderness,And the watersprings into dry ground;

A fruitful
land into barrenness,For the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

He turns
a wilderness into pools of water,And dry land into watersprings.

There He
makes the hungry dwell,That they may establish a city for a dwelling place,

And sow
fields and plant vineyards,That they may yield a fruitful harvest.

He also
blesses them, and they multiply greatly;And He does not let their cattle decrease.

When they
are diminished and brought lowThrough oppression, affliction, and sorrow,

He pours
contempt on princes,And causes them to wander in the wilderness where there is no way;

Yet He
sets the poor on high, far from affliction,And makes their families like a flock.

The righteous
see it and rejoice,And all iniquity stops its mouth.

Whoever is
wise will observe these things,And they will understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
